faqs.q: How long does a metal roof last on an Orange home?

runs.v: Typically 40 to 80 years, per InterNACHI; standing-seam outlasts exposed-fastener metal, and proper attic ventilation extends roof life, per the NRCA.

faqs.q: Is a metal roof too noisy for an Orange two- or three-family rental?

runs.v: No. Solid sheathing, a synthetic underlayment, and attic insulation bring rain noise on a metal roof down to levels comparable to other roofing materials, and an acoustic underlayment helps where there is no attic.

faqs.q: Does a metal roof on an Orange historic property need a Certificate of Appropriateness?

runs.v: It can. Confirm the property's local historic status with the City of Orange Township before exterior work, since a property in a historic district can need extra review; a Register listing alone imposes no restriction.

faqs.q: Do you need a permit for a metal roof in Orange, NJ?

runs.v: A metal re-roof of a detached one- or two-family home is ordinary maintenance under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7, with no construction permit. Commercial, multi-family, and attached buildings need one, and under the 25% rule, repairing more than 25% of the roof area in 12 months requires a permit; as a rule of thumb, damage over 25% also favors a full replacement. Confirm with the City of Orange Township construction office.

faqs.q: Can a metal roof be installed over existing asphalt shingles in Orange?

runs.v: Often, depending on local regulations: over a single layer, on battens that create an air space. N.J.A.C. 5:23-6.4 requires a tear-off when the roof is water-soaked, is wood shake, slate, clay, cement, or asbestos-cement tile, or already carries 2 or more layers, which often applies to Orange's older homes.

faqs.q: How much does metal roof installation or repair cost in Orange, NJ?

runs.v: Install typically runs $9.00–$16.00 per square foot, the going rate for installing metal roofing in New Jersey, and repair $5–$10, with a minor leak at $200–$1,000 and severe corrosion up to $3,000, per published NJ contractor pricing, HomeGuide, and Modernize.

faqs.q: How much does roof replacement with metal cost for a 2,000 sq ft home?

runs.v: Price the roof area, often larger than the floor area: at $9.00–$16.00 per square foot, 2,000 square feet of roof runs roughly $18,000–$32,000 before tear-off, deck repair, or access costs.

faqs.q: What is the biggest problem with metal roofs?

runs.v: Fasteners and seams: exposed-fastener washers degrade and back out, seams separate under thermal movement, and oil-canning and dissimilar-metal corrosion follow. Standing-seam clips reduce all three.
